page.notes: Right margin notes, keyed as printed: a = "aRom.8.18"; b = "bBernh.ser. 1. de Annū-tiat.Mariæ" (the macron over the u in "Annū-" is uncertain, so it is not confirmed); c = "cAct.4.12"; d = "d 1.Cor.1.30"; e = "e Tit.3.5." The NB. note carries no reference letter. The note marks a–e stand in the text at "Apostolus,", "Bernhardum:", "docet", "ille" and "sed". The final "e" mark is at the line end. The first word "se" is a fragment from the previous page. Printed "Utri" is "Vtri" with capital V, set as U. No doubtful readings remain beyond the macron noted above.
